Naija Coke Summership Program 2026: Application Guide

Coca Cola bottling company is delighted to accept application for its 2026 Naija Coke Summership Program for undergraduates students in Nigeria.

Naija Coke Summership Program is a 3-month paid internship program that enables undergraduates to gain skills, mentorship and networking, as well as a career development opportunities.

  • Location: Nigeria

Coca Cola Summership Program 2026 Details

The Naija Coke Summership Program is a three-month internship programme designed to attract third/penultimate year undergraduate students who share our passion for excellence, strive to learn with speed and agility, display creative thinking skills, and work well within a team.

The Coke Summership Program provides a robust developmental platform for students to intern with us to gain industry experience during their academic summer breaks.

This year, the program will hold from July to September. If you fit the profile below, we invite you to make the move and develop your career with us. 

Naija Coke Summership Program 2026 Benefits

The Naija Coke Summership Program offers the following benefits;

  • Confidence & Adaptability: Build the self-assurance and flexibility needed to thrive in fast‑paced work environments.

  • Hands‑On FMCG Exposure: Gain practical exposure during your academic summer break and learn how real businesses operate.

  • Career Exploration: Discover alternative career paths and job roles you may not have previously considered.

  • Monthly 1:1 Mentorship: Receive personalised guidance and career insights through monthly one‑on‑one mentorship sessions with industry leaders.

  • Certificate of Completion: Earn a recognized certificate that validates your experience and strengthens your CV.

  • Post‑Internship Opportunities: Get priority access to NBC recruitment opportunities and potential pathways to join the organization after the internship.

Coca Cola Summership Program Requirements

To be eligible for the Coca Cola Summership Program, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Currently be in the third/penultimate year of undergraduate study in a Nigerian university.

  • Be available to commit to the full internship duration (July – September) 2026

  • Be an undergraduate student only (postgraduate students are not eligible).

  • Strong passion for excellence, ambition, and enthusiasm to be the best.

  • Willingness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a professional environment.

  • Good problem-solving/creative and innovative thinking skills, curiosity, and great appetite for learning

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

Coca Cola Summership Program 2026 Required Documents

  • Your updated CV
